# XY Forever serial protocol 1.33: status codes

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.33](../PROTOCOL.md).

## Status codes

Every reply starts with one. A tool shows a code it does not know by number and treats it as a failure. Besides the errors listed under each command, these can
come to any command, as the status alone (whatever its `on_error` says): `state`, to any command but `hello`: the device has not answered a `hello` since it
started; nothing was done. `unsupported`, to any command but `hello`: this build does not answer the type (it is not in `cmds`). `busy`, to any command but
`hello`: a job is running, or its write window is still closing after `job.status` said it ended: every command that needs processor A, the staging or a boot
waits for it (`diag.status`, `screen.read`, `service.hold`, `job.status` and `job.cancel` are answered). `waiting`, to any command but `hello`: 1.23: the device
asks (`trust`); send it again. `declined`, to any command but `hello`: 1.23: not allowed until unplugged or restarted. `serial_off`, to any command but `hello`:
1.25: USB mode is MTP (`serial`); answered at once.

| Code | Name | Since | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `ok` | 1.0 | done |
| 1 | `bad_request` | 1.0 | malformed request: wrong length, a value out of its allowed set, an invalid path or id |
| 2 | `unsupported` | 1.0 | this build does not answer this type (named `unknown` before 1.1) |
| 3 | `state` | 1.0 | wrong order: no `hello` yet, nothing staged, staging incomplete; the same request will not succeed until something else changes |
| 4 | `range` | 1.0 | an offset or address outside what the command allows |
| 5 | `crc` | 1.0 | a CRC-32 differs (staged data, or a written file read back) |
| 6 | `sha` | 1.0 | a SHA-256 differs (staged data or the confirmation token) |
| 7 | `storage` | 1.0 | a file-system call on the device failed |
| 8 | `not_found` | 1.0 | no such file |
| 9 | `too_large` | 1.0 | a size above its limit (staging capacity, boot partition, whole-file read) |
| 10 | `image` | 1.0 | the staged image is not acceptable for this install |
| 11 | `install` | 1.0 | the boot-partition write or its read-back check failed |
| 12 | `link` | 1.0 | processor A did not answer a request processor B passed on to it within its bound, or did not answer as XY Forever (B asks before it sends a change; 1.17: also before closing a write window left by an unanswered request); once the link is lost every command that needs A answers `link` at once and B stays at its menu until a power cycle |
| 13 | `identity` | 1.0 | stock code in the device's memory differs from the checked bootloader image; the command did not run |
| 14 | `refused` | 1.1 | well formed, but forbidden by the device's safety policy (a path the file engine refuses, or, for a change, outside the write area: since 1.13 all of `/yaffs2/` except `/yaffs2/bootloader.dev` and `/yaffs2/upgrade` with all below it; since 1.16 also a folder made, or a file written, copied or moved, more than 6 folders below `/yaffs2`, the stock dev-menu MTP's limit: docs/SAFETY.md) |
| 15 | `busy` | 1.10 | a job (`mods.apply`) is running, or B is still closing A's write window after it ended (seconds); retry later, or `job.cancel` a running job |
| 16 | `cancelled` | 1.1 | the job was cancelled (not sent by any command yet) |
| 17 | `no_content` | 1.10 | the library entry's content is not installed in `/yaffs2/content/` (a mod set built on the device, or any entry while another one's content is installed): it is listed but does not boot as it is; make it the default to install its content. Added during 1.10 without a version bump: a build that reports 1.10 to 1.16 may answer another status for such an entry; every 1.17 build sends this one |
| 18 | `started` | 1.10 | the request started a job (`library.set_default`: the content switch); follow it with `job.status`, whose end is the request's result |
| 19 | `declined` | 1.11 | not allowed: the user answered Don't allow (Ask before USB control, `hello` `trust`); nothing was done (sent since 1.23) |
| 20 | `waiting` | 1.23 | the device asks the user to allow this computer (no time limit); nothing done: show "Allow on your OP-XY", retry |
| 21 | `serial_off` | 1.25 | serial is off: USB mode on the OP-XY is MTP (Settings, `hello` `serial`); nothing was done. Show "Serial is off on your OP-XY: Settings > USB mode" |
